The structure of Cu2Se3 is tetragonal with space group I4_1/amd (No. 143), containing 20 atoms per unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral environments throughout: Cu centers coordinate to four Se neighbors, while Se centers coordinate to four Cu neighbors, with distances from 2.3098 to 2.4493 Å. The tetrahedral Cu and Se polyhedra exhibit corner- and edge-sharing contacts. A single three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph spans all 20 sites.
